observations: No new photos were provided after the seller’s reply.
The original photo still only shows a TV console with a TV; TV brand/model/size and ports are not readable.
No visible evidence of testing (port connections, device playback, sound) is shown in the photo.

claims.claim: Relocating. come carry this center table and TV console for 140k. sharp deal. Send WhatsApp...
claims.evidence: Only one photo; it clearly shows a TV console with TV, but the 'center table' is not clearly shown or confirmed.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working.
claims.evidence: Seller claims testing, but no test evidence (photos/videos of ports working) is provided; ports are not visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No original pads/receipt are shown in the photo.

risks.risk: The 'center table' may not be included; photo only clearly supports a TV console with TV.
risks.proof: Ask for a full photo of the center table (separate from the console) and confirm dimensions.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV console + TV only (center table not included).

risks.risk: TV brand/model/size is not readable, so the price could be wrong.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the TV back label (brand, model, serial) and screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely category for an older/unknown-size TV.

risks.risk: Ports may still have faults despite the seller’s claim; no test evidence is provided.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing HDMI + USB (or other ports) working with a connected device.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/assume ports may be faulty.

risks.risk: Display/sound issues (dead pixels, lines, audio distortion) can’t be confirmed from one static photo.
risks.proof: Ask for a video playing a test pattern (colors + scrolling text) and a sound check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may have display/sound issues until proven.

risks.risk: Console condition and mounting stability/hardware can’t be verified from one angle.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the back/underside and any mounting hardware/legs/shelves.
risks.if_unproven: Price as standard used condition without guaranteed mounting hardware.

proof_requests: Please send a clear photo of the TV back label (brand, model, serial) and screen size.
Send a short video: plug in a device and show at least 2 ports working (e.g., HDMI and USB).
Send a display test video (no lines/dead pixels) plus a sound check.
If the 'center table' is included, send a full photo of it and its dimensions.
Send photos of the original pads and the UK receipt (or a scan).
response.reason: The seller asserts testing, but without new photos/videos showing the TV model/size and port/display/sound tests, the key details that determine price remain unverified from remote evidence.
